notes: 2026-10-29 (jnco run): homepage meta 'Authentic Stüssy goods. Made tough for the world. Quality guaranteed. Built for the long haul. Shop tees, sweats, outerwear, headwear, denim'. known_for built from it.
Wikipedia infobox: founded '1980s in Laguna Beach, California' by Shawn Stussy; HQ Irvine, California; owner 'The Sinatra family'; no parent company. founded_year left null (no exact year).

Shipping policy: US standard $9, express $15, free standard over $200 (AK/HI/PR etc. $15/$25). International list from stussy.com covers Latin America and Asia (Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Hong Kong, Singapore…); Canada, UK and Australia are not on it, so ships_to records US only.
Refund policy: 7 days from receiving the shipment, by mail only; flat-rate fee with the prepaid label; no exchanges (return and reorder); collaborations and limited editions final sale.

Jeans (products.json): waists 26–38, all 100% cotton, non-stretch, unisex. Big Ol' Jean: 'Oversized waist with a relaxed rise', leg opening circumference 18½" / 47cm (size 32). New Classic Jean: classic fit, straight cut, 14.5oz, 17½" leg opening circumference.
